deviations_from_card: (1) Critic revise applied: probe.py added to the write set. frame_name() records shots/<lane-dir>/<shot>.png as '<lane-dir>--<shot>.png' (= truth_id + '.png'), and a new --shots LANE_DIR flag annotates a lane's shots, skipping the 00-* hero stills. Case 5 is end to end: a stubbed run_lane resumes over a COPY of the tracked reference-face-e25/lane.json, so the resume guard runs against the real record. probe.main with a faked Gemini backend writes results.jsonl, and score.load_truth resolves that real row to the sidecar run_lane wrote. (2) This answers ONE of the critic-2026-10-07 open questions: the first, how shot PNGs reach probe.py under lane-qualified names. The second, who settles the arguable values ('slightly above eye level', 'Tight close-up'), is NOT answered. It is deferred: those phrases are recorded as contested under _ungraded with their candidates, and a human still has to decide them. (3) The labels live in craft_spec.LABELS, and consistency.SHOTS_SPEC/ZOOM_SPEC reference them as the third tuple element. They are not written inline in consistency.py, because score.py has to recompute the current digest without importing the render module (guard, urllib), as the critic noted. Case 2 asserts that every phrase is a substring of its clause. (4) The lexicon is NOT shared with replicate.compose_prompt (the earlier critic's write set wanted that; replicate.py is outside this card's write set). (5) The tests are in a Node probe spec that spawns python, following the lane-record/lane-params precedent, not in selftest.py; selftest.py is untouched and still 39 green. (6) Sidecars are written only for shots run_lane actually renders. There is no backfill of the 18 existing renders, which is out of scope per the critic.
notes: No tracked data files were needed or generated. Sidecars are minted at render time by consistency.run_lane on the GPU box. *.truth.json under shots/ is not gitignored (only png/jpg are), so future sidecars will be tracked. Basis 'dictated+confirmed' has no producer yet; truth_admit, the blind pass, is stage 2 because it spends the seat. Until then score.py names every sidecar 'unscored: awaiting confirmation', so accuracy is unchanged on real runs. Guard Case 9 shows the hand truth (arcane, duel-keyframe) score rows are byte-identical to abd803b; the report only gains an 'n' row and a basis line per truth frame. The kit census is unaffected: new files are under pipeline/ and tests/ only.
